preregistrations.hypothesis: Changing only training initialization cannot change combined data generation bytes or semantic identity.

gate.baseline: same generation config with scratch initialization
gate.uncertainty_rule: exact deterministic equality; no sampling uncertainty
gate.multiplicity_handling: all train and validation shards must pass
gate.decision_rule: PASS iff mismatch count equals zero and generation semantic hashes are equal
gate.cost_ceiling: CPU tests only; no production data, GPU, or strength match

preregistrations.hypothesis: The unchanged R3 teacher remains deterministic and accurate enough for label-blind finite-cohort replenishment.
A fresh isolated decision block confirms the unchanged teacher and authorizes a feature-aware, label-blind replacement selection policy.
Deterministic label-blind replenishment can produce the exact finite 1M pilot and 4096 deep-core while preserving declared mixtures and coverage.

outcomes.outcome: pass: train and validation shard bytes and generation semantic identities were equal across both training initializations
proves: The strict combined generation API and orchestration are independent of the separate training initialization for the registered deterministic fixture.
does_not_prove: Teacher strength, training quality, production runtime correctness, or Elo.

outcomes.outcome: valid closeout selected r3 because retained feature coverage missed the frozen direct-route bound
pass: unchanged teacher requalified and replacement R4 authorized
pass: all 23 replacement R4 gates true; exact finite 1M pilot and 4,096-record deep core produced; R5 authorized
proves: The frozen replacement policy produced the exact finite datasets while passing authorization-chain, identity, isolation, coverage, missingness, cost, regeneration, and no-downstream-work gates.
